overview.en: Crenicara punctulatum is a small South American cichlid widespread in the upper Amazon and also recorded in the Essequibo basin.
overview.fr: Crenicara punctulatum est un petit cichlidé sud-américain répandu dans le haut Amazone et également signalé dans le bassin de l’Essequibo.

identification.en: Its dark checkerboard flank pattern gives the species its common name; it is similar to C. latruncularium, which differs in several meristic and colour characters.
identification.fr: Son motif sombre en damier sur les flancs lui donne son nom commun ; il ressemble à C. latruncularium, qui diffère par plusieurs caractères méristiques et chromatiques.

habitat.en: It is recorded from forest creeks and sandy river shores, often near fallen leaves or among aquatic plants.
habitat.fr: Il est signalé dans des ruisseaux forestiers et sur des rives sableuses, souvent près des feuilles tombées ou parmi les plantes aquatiques.

diet.en: Kullander’s redescription does not provide a detailed natural prey inventory, so no specialized diet is assigned here.
diet.fr: La redescription de Kullander ne donne pas d’inventaire détaillé des proies naturelles ; aucun régime spécialisé ne lui est donc attribué ici.

behavior.en: Claims that this species changes sex have appeared in older sources, but the status of C. punctulatum as a true sex-changing fish remains disputed.
behavior.fr: Des sources anciennes lui ont attribué un changement de sexe, mais le statut de C. punctulatum comme poisson réellement hermaphrodite séquentiel reste contesté.

reproduction.en: It lays eggs attached to plants or stones, and the female tends the clutch; reported egg numbers vary among compiled summaries.
reproduction.fr: Il pond des œufs fixés aux plantes ou aux pierres, et la femelle garde la ponte ; les nombres d’œufs rapportés varient selon les synthèses compilées.

ecology.en: It is a benthopelagic freshwater fish of tropical lowland streams and shores, sharing its genus with the more localized C. latruncularium.
ecology.fr: C’est un poisson dulçaquicole tropical benthopélagique des cours d’eau et de leurs rives, qui partage son genre avec C. latruncularium, à l’aire plus localisée.

conservation.en: FishBase relays a global IUCN assessment of Least Concern; this status is distinct from the contested details of its reproductive biology.
conservation.fr: FishBase relaie une évaluation mondiale UICN en préoccupation mineure ; ce statut est distinct des incertitudes concernant sa biologie reproductive.

title.en: Cichlid fishes of the Amazon River drainage of Peru — Sven O. Kullander
title.fr: Les poissons cichlidés du bassin péruvien de l’Amazone — Sven O. Kullander

facts: The monograph redescribes C. punctulatum, illustrates its checkerboard pattern and gives its broad geographic range; it does not detail a prey inventory.
FishBase compiles forest-creek and sandy-shore habitat, egg attachment and female care, broad range, and the global IUCN Least Concern assessment.

title.en: Fish and sex change in Crenicara punctulata — Carruth, 2000, Copeia
title.fr: Changement sexuel chez Crenicara punctulata — Carruth, 2000, Copeia

facts: Carruth’s study used gonadal histology to test published reports of protogyny; later cichlid reviews caution that the species is not generally accepted as a confirmed sex changer.

title.en: Epigenetic regulation and environmental sex determination in cichlid fishes — review
title.fr: Régulation épigénétique et détermination environnementale du sexe chez les cichlidés — revue

facts: The review notes evidence debated for Crenicara punctulatum and cautions that experts generally do not regard it as a confirmed sex-changing cichlid.

uncertainties: The name appears as Crenicara punctulata in some modern catalogues and databases, while the inventory uses punctulatum; the taxonomic catalog regards punctulata as valid and punctulatum as a frequent alternative spelling.
Sex-change reports are contested; the entry does not present protogyny as settled biology.
No direct reciprocal profile edit was requested for the already-existing C. latruncularium entry; this draft contains the reverse reference.
review_note: Compared Kullander’s taxonomic redescription with FishBase and the modern catalog spelling; treated the disputed sex-change claim cautiously using a primary histology study and a later specialist review, and linked to C. latruncularium.
